meta.description: Registry for bounded recursive class-membership drift and admissibility-sensitive category-transition behavior in Phase 3.

recursive_class_drift_entries.name: Recursive Class Membership Drift
recursive_class_drift_entries.purpose: Represent bounded recursive class-membership drift and admissibility-sensitive category-transition behavior.

class_membership_conditions.name: recursive_class_membership_drift_remains_defined
class_membership_conditions.description: Formal support for evaluating how process-state membership in an equivalence class changes under recursion.

class_membership_conditions.name: category_transition_behavior_remains_detectable
class_membership_conditions.description: The system must maintain metrics for identifying when a process state crosses boundary-case thresholds into a new category.

class_membership_conditions.name: classification_updates_under_recursion_remain_admissible
class_membership_conditions.description: Re-classification following a recursive update must respect current process admissibility windows.

class_membership_conditions.name: window_boundary_drift_does_not_force_global_class_collapse
class_membership_conditions.description: Drift in the window boundary does not imply the merger of all process states into a single trivial equivalence class.

class_membership_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_classification_bias_remains_bounded
class_membership_conditions.description: The influence of frame orientation on category assignment must stay within stable limits.

class_membership_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_class_transition_witness
class_membership_conditions.description: Pruning must not eliminate all possible states transitioning between defined process classes.

class_membership_conditions.name: recursive_equivalence_fragmentation_remains_classifiable
class_membership_conditions.description: Fragmentation of equivalence classes into multi-valued clusters must map to registered transition modes.

class_membership_conditions.name: classification_instability_under_recursion_remains_detectable
class_membership_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of recursive classification stability.
